description: Extreme Event Game is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Lab X; National Academies Resilient America Roundtable. This in-person role-playing game gives participants a taste of what it takes to build community resilience in the face of disaster. Starting with an earthquake, hurricane, or flood scenario, players work together to make decisions and solve problems during an engaging, fast-paced simulation. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Flooding – Coastal, Flooding – General, High Winds. Assets: Critical Facilities, People, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
